messages:
emma: Hey sec team — got an email titled 'Action required: Verify service login for infra-redbox' with a link to hxxp://verify-infra[.]com/login. It asked for a service token. I did NOT click. Attaching screenshot.
sec-oncall: thanks emma — please forward the full raw message (headers) and the sender address. don't click anything.
emma: forwarded to sec@redwood.com. Pasted headers below: From: alerts@infra-notify.io
Received-SPF: fail
DKIM: none
Message-ID: <20240301.1234@infra-notify.io>
Link in body: tinyurl.com/abc123 -> redirects to verify-infra.com/login
sec-oncall: noted. tagging jonas + maria to triage. @sec-bot start sandbox scan on tinyurl.com/abc123
sec-bot: Sandbox scan started for tinyurl.com/abc123 -> resolves to verify-infra.com (200). Observed form POST /token-verify and JS that exfiltrates form data to api.malicious-collect.me. Indicators: api.malicious-collect.me, verify-infra.com, tinyurl.com/abc123. No executable payload. scan id sbx-20240301-87.
jonas: sounds like credential harvesting redirect. Any clicks from internal IPs or SSO records?
maria: checking logs now — running CloudFront + SSO queries: `index=cloudfront status=200 url="/login" host=verify-infra.com` found 1 hit from 52.23.134.11 at 2024-03-01T13:05:34. Matches emma's reported time. No SSO auth transactions tied to that host. Likely no token exchange completed.
sec-oncall: OK. Containment plan: 1) block verify-infra.com + api.malicious-collect.me at perimeter 2) add tinyurl.com/abc123 to URL filter 3) verify whether any service tokens were exposed and rotate if needed. Emma — you said you didn't enter anything?
emma: I did not enter any token or click further. machine hostname is laptop-ems-01.
thomas: recommend we force rotation for any long-lived service keys issued in last 6 months that might be referenced by notification emails. I'll spin up a ticket for infra-key-rotation.
it-helpdesk: we'll run EDR checks on laptop-ems-01 and quarantine if suspicious. Emma — please keep laptop powered and connected to VPN while we scan.
maria: EDR query: `host:laptop-ems-01 AND outbound_domain:"api.malicious-collect.me"` -> no hits. Email header also shows X-Originating-IP: 45.77.90.12. infra-notify.io created 2024-02-28 (whois new).
jonas: adding IOCs to blocklist and creating a PSIRT ticket. I'll also add a quick user comms template. We should include redemption steps if someone clicked.
sec-oncall: post-incident checklist (short):
- block domains/urls (netsec)
- EDR scan & host containment (ops)
- rotate any at-risk tokens (infra)
- notify affected teams + update incident log (sec)
- add sample to phishing training pool (devex/security)
Owners: domain block -> jonas; EDR -> it-helpdesk; token rotation -> thomas; comms -> maria.
maria: drafting internal advisory now: `internal:security - Heads up: suspicious credential phishing via verify-infra.com. DO NOT click links asking for tokens. If you clicked, contact sec@redwood.com immediately.` Will post in 30m.
sec-bot: URL block rule created: verify-infra.com added to blocklist (rule id bl-4487). tinyurl.com/abc123 flagged at proxy (rule id bl-4490).
emma: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
